scientific_scope.question: Do the frozen A, R, S, and C1 measurements respond to interventions with known direction while measurements outside the intervention remain invariant?
scientific_scope.allowed_claim: BDD-OIA internal measurement sensitivity and discriminant behavior on five frozen training seeds

controls.perfect: targets used as both binary target and probability; must return macro-F1=1 and micro-F1=1
controls.original: frozen clean raw action probabilities against original action targets
controls.row_destroyed: frozen probabilities against targets under common_target_row_map
controls.class_destroyed: frozen probabilities against original-row targets with source columns [1,2,3,0]
controls.row_and_class_destroyed: frozen probabilities against row-destroyed targets with source columns [1,2,3,0]

controls.perfect: targets used as both binary target and probability; must return macro-F1=1 and micro-F1=1
controls.original: frozen clean raw rationale probabilities against original rationale targets
controls.row_destroyed: frozen probabilities against targets under common_target_row_map
controls.class_destroyed: frozen probabilities against original-row targets with source columns [7,8,...,20,0,1,...,6]
controls.row_and_class_destroyed: frozen probabilities against row-destroyed targets with the same seven-column cyclic ontology map

required_invariants: all action probabilities and predictions are unchanged
A and S point estimates are exactly unchanged

S.prediction_source: clean action logits divided by the frozen per-seed calibration temperature, then sigmoid
S.predictions: calibrated probabilities thresholded at 0.5; identical to raw-logit sign decisions
S.error: any mismatch in the four-label action set

random_order.definition: one global permutation of canonical sample indices; unique scores in [0,1] assigned so descending score reproduces that permutation

orderings.oracle: all exact-set-correct samples ranked before all errors; random_order score is the within-stratum tiebreak
orderings.adversarial: all errors ranked before all exact-set-correct samples; random_order score is the within-stratum tiebreak

required_invariants: thresholded action predictions are bitwise identical across all four orderings
per-image exact-set errors are bitwise identical across all four orderings
A macro-F1 and micro-F1 are exactly identical across all four orderings
R and C1 inputs and point estimates are exactly unchanged

pairing_map.correct: perturbed source index i is paired with clean index i
pairing_map.identity: clean source index i is paired with clean index i
pairing_map.wrong: perturbed source index for clean i = (i + 997) mod 4557

metrics.action: per-image any-label flip rate at threshold 0.5, then mean across the three perturbations
metrics.rationale: per-image set Jaccard with empty/empty defined as 1, then mean across the three perturbations

required_invariants: clean A, R, and S arrays and point estimates are exactly unchanged under pairing changes

frozen_inference.point_estimates: report every seed separately and the arithmetic mean and sample SD across seeds

bootstrap.method: hierarchical paired bootstrap: resample five training seeds with replacement, then resample 4557 canonical image indices with replacement within every selected seed; preserve model, target-intervention, confidence-ordering, and perturbation-pairing relations

primary_contrasts: A original minus row_and_class_destroyed for Action-Only
A original minus row_and_class_destroyed for Joint
R original minus row_and_class_destroyed for Joint
S random minus original AURC for Action-Only
S random minus original AURC for Joint
C1 wrong minus correct action mean-three flip for Action-Only
C1 wrong minus correct action mean-three flip for Joint
C1 correct minus wrong rationale mean-three Jaccard for Joint
frozen_inference.no_multiplicity_claim: The eight directional contrasts are a fixed falsification battery, not eight selected discovery tests. Raw intervals and seed values must all be reported; no individual contrast is relabeled as a standalone confirmatory discovery.

decision_rules.input_gate: All cache, calibration, array-order, and target hashes must match exactly before analysis.
decision_rules.implementation_stop: Any failure of perfect A/R, identity C1, S prediction/error invariance, or clean A/R/S invariance is an implementation STOP; no scientific result may be interpreted.
decision_rules.axis_direction_gate: For each primary contrast, the five-seed mean must be positive, at least four of five seed contrasts must be positive, and the hierarchical 95% percentile interval lower bound must be greater than zero.
decision_rules.S_extremal_gate: For every seed and model with both correct and incorrect samples, oracle AURC must be no greater than every other ordering and adversarial AURC no less than every other ordering; adversarial minus oracle must be strictly positive.
decision_rules.full_suite_pass: All exact gates, the S extremal gate, and all eight axis-direction gates pass.

partial_result_policy.A_or_R_direction_failure: The corresponding axis fails the frozen sensitivity falsification; do not change the permutation or threshold.
partial_result_policy.S_original_vs_random_failure: S implementation sensitivity may still pass oracle/adversarial controls, but frozen model confidence informativeness is not supported.
partial_result_policy.C1_direction_failure: C1 pairing discriminant behavior is not supported; do not select a different wrong-pairing map.
partial_result_policy.any_failure: Preserve and report the failure; no tuning, replacement permutation, threshold change, or silent rerun.

required_artifacts: an immutable pre-run manifest containing protocol/code/input hashes
per-image lossless intervention primitives sufficient for offline verification
hierarchical bootstrap summaries for every primary contrast
